title: Every stage failure maps to non-retryable stage-failed, so WEBINAR_PIPELINE retry lists and maxAttempts are dead in the wired path; a transient network error or file lock fails the run (dead job) and costs a whole new generation
area: scripts/webinar/graph/graph-finalize.mjs:15,24 (guard -> STAGE_FAILED); packages/core/src/domain/pipeline-workflow.ts:170-174 (retryable io-error, provider-timeout, provider-5xx, rate-limited, db-unavailable)
evidence: D-139 says a run fails terminally only when retries are exhausted; the planner defines per-stage retryable codes, but no handler can ever return one. Not permanent: the next tick resubmits a new generation (test proves), but that re-runs completed stages (transcript/screen re-ran in the real-queue test) and burns run-pipeline attempts.
fix_direction: Classify child exit/error into io-error / provider-timeout / provider-5xx / rate-limited / db-unavailable (exit code or stderr class), keep stage-failed for the rest. Needs real error classes from the children.

title: Heartbeat test does not discriminate: disabling the lease heartbeat timer (everyMs > 0 -> false) still passes session-run.test.ts
evidence: Mutation M4 survived (6/6 pass). The runner itself heartbeats on every step, so >=5 beats arise from 5 stages without the interval timer; the 120 ms slow stage never outlasts a lease. Stale-lease handling for a long stage is unproven.
fix_direction: Count beats during one slow stage only (single-stage workflow or beats between started and succeed), or assert the lease is still live after a stage longer than leaseMs.
